summary: NetEase, Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held on June 23, 2026, at which shareholders passed all proposed resolutions, including a special resolution to adopt a Third Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association. The filing is a routine corporate governance update with no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender offer, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K corresponds to a US Form 8-K Item 5.07 disclosure of shareholder meeting results. The filing is purely administrative and non-eventful from a special-situations perspective.
